changelog:
Initial release of Image Inpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy:

- Enables mask-driven image inpainting via the runcomfy CLI, routing to Z-Image Turbo Inpainting for precise region edits.
- Automatically falls back to instruction-driven edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't provided.
- Supports use cases like object removal, watermark cleanup, region replacement, and blemish fixes.
- Detailed CLI usage instructions and model selection guidance included.
- Requires the runcomfy CLI and a valid RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.
display_name: Image Inpainting — Pro Pack on RunComfy
summary: Mask-driven image inpainting on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes to Tongyi MAI Z-Image Turbo Inpainting (the dedicated inpainting endpoint with mask, strength, and control-scale) and to identity-preserving edit models (Nano Banana 2 Edit, GPT Image 2 Edit, FLUX Kontext Pro) when a mask isn't available and the region must be described instead. Use for object removal, watermark removal, region replacement, blemish cleanup, and any controlled local edit where a binary mask defines the target area. Triggers on "inpaint", "inpainting", "image inpaint", "remove from image", "fill region", "mask-driven edit", "remove watermark", "remove object", "patch the photo", "fill the hole", or any explicit ask to edit a specific masked region of a still.
